purpose: 005 T003 preselected questions, fixed before any timed Foundry query
rule:
Preselect the 20 T003 definition/reference questions from producer + source evidence.

Deterministic rule (fixed before any Foundry query or timing):
- global symbol, exactly one definition occurrence in the artifact, defined under
  library/{std,alloc,core}/src/ outside test files; descriptor is a type (`#`) or a
  function/method (`().`);
- the definition range and every reference range read exactly the symbol's name in
  the frozen snapshot bytes (UTF-8 line/column -> byte conversion);
- supported (15): 3..60 distinct reference ranges in at most 30 files; the first five
  per crate (std, alloc, core) in SHA-256(symbol) order;
- high-degree (5): more than 256 distinct reference ranges; the first five in
  SHA-256(symbol) order, at most two per crate.
Expected sets are the distinct (path, start, end) reference ranges of that symbol.
canonical_expected_encoding: compact JSON array of [path,start,end] in (path,start,end) order; expected_sha256 is its SHA-256
source_check_method: three read-only agents read definition/import/module/type context and classified every same-name lexical candidate (supported) or the first 64 references in order (high-degree); host cfg aarch64-apple-darwin plus rust-analyzer default cfgs (debug_assertions, miri)
